invariants.rationale: In Java, the args parameter in main is always non-null and can be empty but not negative in length.

meta.value: The args array is never null and has non-negative length at method entry.

invariants.rationale: At method entry, args is a String array.

meta.value: The args parameter is an array of String, so its class is an array.

invariants.rationale: Checking that args is an instance of String[] confirms its expected type.

meta.value: The args parameter is of type String[].
